findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hatch, lookup, list, checkout, share, poll_decision, get_pairing_code · Private data: hatch, upload, checkout, auth, share, poll_pairing, refresh_session, deploy · Public sink: hatch, upload, convert, checkout, poll_checkout, share, await_decision, deploy · Destructive: auth, share.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hatch, lookup, list, checkout, share, poll_decision, get_pairing_code · Private data: hatch, upload, checkout, auth, share, poll_pairing, refresh_session, deploy · Public sink: hatch, upload, convert, checkout, poll_checkout, share, await_decision, deploy · Destructive: auth, share

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
